verdict.rationale: Maritime documents natural-language operation in two ways. You can paste one prompt into Claude, Cursor or another assistant, and it installs the CLI, authenticates and deploys agents. That CLI is built to be driven by AI agents, with JSON output, stable exit codes and a self-describing contract. Separately, telling a template agent something like "send me a digest every weekday at 9" is turned into real wake triggers. The core story is delivered, but it depends mostly on external assistants driving the CLI rather than a built-in control surface. missing for 10: a first-party natural-language console for managing the platform, documented natural-language coverage beyond deploy/migrate/scheduling (e.g. config, keys, billing), independent or hands-on corroboration.
